description: Ireland: how a UK pension is taxed for an Irish resident. UK State Pension: Irish income tax, no USC. UK workplace/private pension or annuity: taxed only in Ireland (Ireland-UK treaty Art. 17), income tax and USC, no PRSI; form Ireland-Individual stops UK tax. UK government service pension: taxed only in the UK unless an Irish national (Art. 18). Optional foreign pension lump sum under s.200A: EUR 200,000 lifetime tax-free (counting lump sums since 7 Dec 2005), 20% to EUR 500,000, 40% plus USC above.
